summary: No advisory committee was convened for Horizant (gabapentin enacarbil, NDA 022399). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review explicitly records that the decision was made not to present the application to an advisory committee, citing that gabapentin enacarbil is rapidly converted to gabapentin, that the safety of gabapentin is established at higher exposures, and that efficacy at 600 mg/day was demonstrated. Because no AC meeting occurred, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
